title: RetrievalProfile
description: Named, versioned retrieval configuration. Behavior changes happen by switching or versioning profiles, never by editing live behavior in place. The query embedding model must equal each referenced index's embedding model (validator-enforced). Default Scripture retrieval profile changes require an owner decision.

x_contract_metadata.authority_note: Planning metadata only; not governance authority and not authorization to run embeddings, build indexes, generate graph edges, import boundary corpora, choose a backend, or promote retrieval profiles.

index_ids.description: Multiple indexes allowed only when all share the same embedding model and corpus class

default_for_scripture.description: True only for the one default Scripture retrieval profile; changing which profile is default requires an owner decision

includes_boundary_material.description: Must be false when default_for_scripture is true; boundary/reception material is an explicit opt-in profile choice, never the default
